text_block_list.text:
One day during summer training camp.
Around the time training had ended and free time began for everyone—

Air Groove is alone in the break area,
deep in thought. On the table in front of her
lie what look like notes and writing utensils...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmhââ
It's you, is it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Just in time.
I was just thinking I'd like to hear a professional's opinion.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Take a look at this.

Air Groove stares at the notes on the table.
Upon picking them up, I see a training menu written there.

There was a considerable volume to it, making it fairly grueling...
Yet for Air Groove, it seemed to consist mostly of fundamentals.
choice_data_list: Is this menu specifically for Air Groove?
Is this menu specifically for Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, this is an independent training menu for
Umamusume attending summer camp for the first time next year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is intended for use when Trainer guidance is unavailable,
or when an Umamusume wishes to undergo additional voluntary training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I want to present an example
so our underclassmen won't get stuck and waste their time.

To think she was considering such things for her junior
even while having her own training for the Shuka Sho to manage.

Seeing once again how caring Air Groove truly is,
I decided to lend a hand as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—Hm.
It got this late before I even realized...”
Before I knew it, Air Groove and I had been debating right up until lights-out...
As a result, however, what started out as a single menu was divided into specialized regimens tailored to the specific abilities to be trained.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, splendid results.
I'd expect nothing less from my Trainer.
choice_data_list: Good work out there, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You go to bed early tonight too.
We've got an early start tomorrow.

The next day.
After finishing our joint training—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —There you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will now begin testing the regimen created yesterday.
Join me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why the surprise? I can hardly have you practice
something that hasn't been verified yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the creators, it is our duty to test it responsibly.
It is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. Who do you take me for?
Besides, this is hardly a bad deal for you either.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"After all, it is a great opportunity to conduct
focused training in preparation for the Shuka Sho."

Air Groove flashed a daring smile as she said that.
With things turning out like this, I have no choice but to go along with it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright. You choose the menu, then.
Which of the ones we made yesterday do you want to try?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A routine focusing on the basics,
evenly training muscle strength throughout the entire body...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why we must verify it meticulously.
Very well, let us proceed with that."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm itching for a race...!
Afterward, together with Air Groove, we reviewed her training regimen against the backdrop of the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Now this is a great menu...!

"Seeing Air Groove steadily push through such severe demands
without voicing a single complaint makes you truly respect her."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Senpai is truly always putting in the effort, no matter what happens..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can even challenge
the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then I'll—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alright—I can keep going.

Several junior Umamusume watch from afar
as Air Groove devotes herself to training.
...Air Groove must have looked truly dazzling in their eyes too.

"And so, Air Groove
splendidly saw through the verification
of the training menu to the very end."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Doing shuttle runs at nearly full speed on the sand.
Because of its simplicity, it's the most mentally
grueling routine...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think you would dare to choose that.
However, that makes it all the more rewarding for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
This time, you will also assist in pushing my limits.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If my pace slows down even a bit
before we hit our target reps, give me an earful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Keep an eye on my stamina and push me right to the absolute limit. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I will exceed whatever
limits you've presumed. Come at me ready for a real battle.

A hellish shuttle run on the sandy beach commenced,
and slowly but surely, Air Groove's
stamina was drained away—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Kh, just what I wanted!

Air Groove flashed a fearless smile and resumed her pace.
Seeing her display even more grit than I had imagined,
I couldn't help but be impressed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai is always pushing beyond her limits, no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can stand proud...
and take on the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then I'll—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not yet!

Several junior Umamusume watched from afar
as Air Groove pushed past her limits.
...Air Groove must have looked truly dazzling in their eyes too.

Right before their eyes,
Air Groove brilliantly completed all her targeted laps...
